result.one_liner: Customer communication and support platform with contact management, messaging, and help desk features.

evidence.quote: OAuth is for if you're building a public app that accesses other people's Intercom data. Access Tokens are for if you're using the API to access data in your own Intercom workspace.
API is included in paid plans. Entry point Essential plan $29/seat/month. No permanent free tier.
Intercom exposes a REST API (currently at v2.15) over HTTPS with JSON request and response bodies.
REST API covers contacts, conversations, tickets, help center articles, workflows, and Fin AI Agent endpoints.
API access requires paid subscription starting at $29/seat/month with no free tier alternative.

result.notes: Intercom requires a paid plan for API access with no free tier option. Authentication uses OAuth for public apps or Bearer tokens for private workspace apps. API is REST-only with no GraphQL endpoint. Rate limits are 10,000 calls/minute per app or 25,000/minute per workspace.
